UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user cross-device preferences including app lock status, PIN hash, and UI language.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated owner (must match request.auth.uid).

appLockEnabled.description: Whether the master app lock is enabled on startup.

appPinHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the user's master app PIN, or empty string if unset.

languageCode.description: Preferred UI language code ('en' for English, 'ar' for Arabic).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last settings update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Note.title: Note
Note.description: A private personal note synced across the user's devices with optional per-note PIN lock.

userId.description: The UID of the note owner (must match request.auth.uid).

category.description: Category identifier for organizing notes (1 to 50 characters).

colorIndex.description: Palette index (0 to 5) for card visual styling.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the vault.

isLocked.description: Whether this individual note is locked behind a PIN.

notePinHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the individual note PIN (up to 128 chars).

lockHint.description: Optional hint displayed when the note is locked (up to 100 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user vault lock settings and language preferences.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores private synced notes belonging exclusively to the user.
